privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.contact: Questions about this policy? Write to:
privacy.s1Desc: We don’t ask for sign-up or personal data. Technical data, such as browser type and pages visited, may be collected automatically.
privacy.s2Desc: We store your language and theme preferences in your browser. Ads use cookies, as explained below.
privacy.s3Desc: Google and its partners may use cookies to show ads based on previous visits to this and other websites.
privacy.s4Desc: To keep the site running, understand usage in aggregate and show ads.
privacy.s5Desc: We don’t sell data. Technical information may be processed by Google under its own policies.
privacy.s6Desc: You can clear this site’s data in your browser and turn off personalized ads in Google’s ad settings.
privacy.s7Desc: If you visit us from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, we ask for your consent before cookies are used for personalized advertising, through Google’s consent platform. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time with the button below or the link in the footer.
